memory_candidates.content: CSLib's primitive .bot constructor eliminates both [Bot Atom] and [Inhabited Atom] requirements from Thomas's algebraic completeness code. derivationTop and derivableIn_top require only [DecidableEq Atom] because top = .bot -> .bot uses primitive .bot, not an arbitrary atom. This is a strict improvement over the Bot-as-atom approach.

Thomas's Theory.complete theorem does NOT require Dedekind-MacNeille completion. By stating completeness over GHA (not HA), the Lindenbaum quotient suffices directly. D-M completion is only needed to (1) state MPL completeness over HA instead of GHA, or (2) prove the conservative extension theorem (ipl_conservative_over_mpl). Core completeness works without D-M.

BooleanAlgebra.ofRegular in Mathlib (Heyting._root_.BooleanAlgebra.ofRegular) promotes a HeytingAlgebra to BooleanAlgebra given that every element is regular (complement-complement = identity). For the Lindenbaum algebra, regularity is exactly DNE: DerivableIn T ({neg neg A} ⊢ A). This avoids manually proving all BooleanAlgebra fields.
